title: TextVN user configuration v1
$comment: TextVN config.v1. SPDX header cua file nay nam trong REUSE.toml (khong dat trong JSON - reuse lint se doc nham).

config_version.$comment: BAT BUOC (P0-3 §1): thieu = schema error. Version khac = can migrate.

diacritic_style.$comment: new = hoà (dau o am cuoi), old = hòa (dau o am dau) - bug B12

auto_restore_english.$comment: fix bug B5: tra lai chuoi giong khi fold ra khong phai am tiet Viet

quick_telex.$comment: OpenKey Quick Telex: cc->ch gg->gi kk->kh nn->ng qq->qu pp->ph tt->th (phu am dau, chi Telex)

english_words.$comment: Tu tieng Anh giu nguyen khi Telex bien thanh chuoi co dau trong nhu tieng Viet (text -> tễt). MAC DINH RONG va khong bat san: `test` -> `tết` la ca mo ho nguoc lai (tết la tu Viet that) - bat san se pha tieng Viet. Mau: data/stop_en.txt

enabled.$comment: Tab hoan tat tu tieng Viet tu 3000 am tiet tan suat cao (0.2.33). Mac dinh TAT - Tab di qua app nhu cu. Cac truong khac (provider, ollama - spec P0-3) chua dung.

trigger.$comment: Phim kich hoat hoan tat tu (vong 24). tab_and_space: Space cung hoan tat tu (kem space) khi tu dang go CHUA phai tu dung hoan chinh - khong bao gio viet lai tu da dung.

suggest.$comment: Go y hoan tat tu. Chi `enabled` duoc engine dung hien tai.

mode.$comment: P4-0 §7. off = khong kiem tra (kill-switch cua nguoi dung); highlight = chi goi y (Mode 1, MAC DINH tu 0.2.38); autocorrect = tu sua loi objective + goi y loi mo ho (Mode 2).

auto_fix.$comment: P4-0 §4.3. safe = CHI tu sua luat objective (D7); loi mo ho luon chi goi y.

language.$comment: v1 CHI ho tro vi (D9). en/auto giu cho tuong lai, chua co engine.

trigger_keys.$comment: Diem KIEM TRA im lang (D11) - moi lan go cac phim nay thi kiem tra cau vua go; hien thi con theo `display`.

show_on_sentence_end.$comment: Hien khi gap dau ket thuc cau . ! ?

idle_ms.$comment: Nguoi dung ngung go bao lau (ms) thi hien goi y (P4-0 §4.1).

show_on_comma.$comment: Mac dinh TAT: hien ngay khi go dau phay se spam UI khi go thuong (D11).

hide_on_auto_fix.$comment: Vong 28: khi Tu sua loi dang chay - KHONG hien panel goi y con lai sau khi auto-fix (text da duoc sua lang le). Mac dinh FALSE - van hien loi con lai.

display.$comment: Diem HIEN THI tach khoi diem kiem tra (D11).

max_sentence_chars.$comment: Do dai toi da cua cau duoc kiem tra, tinh theo KY TU Unicode (P4-0 §4.1: <= 500).

per_app.$comment: Bat/tat rieng theo app_id (lowercase). Vi du: {"notepad": true, "code.exe": false}. Thieu = dung chung.

assist.$comment: Tro ly ngu phap (Phan 4 - P4-0 §7). Toan bo mac dinh TAT: bat la lua chon ro rang cua nguoi dung (D20).
